findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "finance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_token_price, check_sanctions · Private data: sec_company_lookup, get_token_price · Public sink: sec_company_lookup, get_token_price, check_sanctions · Destructive: validate_identifier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_token_price, check_sanctions · Private data: sec_company_lookup, get_token_price · Public sink: sec_company_lookup, get_token_price, check_sanctions · Destructive: validate_identifier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
